review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: Creature foot part (PROPOSED): an otter's webbed and padded hind foot, five short plump toes fanned wide with a web nearly to the tips, dark pads under the palm and toes, short pale claws.

textures.name: T_PartFootOtter_Albedo
textures.packing: greyscale albedo detail (baked AO darkens crevices), times each material's base colour

textures.name: T_PartFootOtter_ORM
textures.packing: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

handles.meaning: toes fanned up to 12 degrees further apart, the outer ones most
toes about 30% longer along their own directions

part_rules.handles_note: Both keys are on all four meshes (FootOtter, FootOtterWeb, FootOtterPads, FootOtterClaws) with the same names; the runtime sets them together.
part_rules.pivot_note: Ground part: the sole sits on the pivot; the ankle top (z 0.09 m) meets the limb tip.

reduction.method: Blender collapse decimation within a surface tolerance; full-detail shading baked to the normal map

review_notes.gate1_shape: pass: a broad furred palm and five short plump toes fanned from -70 to +70 degrees with a web between them reaching nearly to the tips, its free edge scalloped back between the toes (clear from above, gray_top); a dark pad under each toe tip shows under it from the side, the palm pad's rim round the base; short pale claws. H1_Spread fans the toes further, H2_Long draws them out, and the web, pads and claws follow with no tearing. In a scratch geometry preview before the first build, the first draft's toes were too fat for their spacing and hid the web, and cp._foot_handles tore the outer toes (its spread switches on at y = 0.02 with no blend), so this part has its own eased handles.
review_notes.gate2_materials: pass: four finishes - brown short-furred skin on the palm and toes, a darker, smoother web membrane with fine veins, near-black glossy leather pads, ivory claws.
review_notes.gate3_neutral_light: pass: under the neutral white rig the web reads as a darker membrane between lit toes, the pads stay dark without crushing and the claws bright without clipping.
review_notes.gate4_godot: unverified: not yet seen in the creature editor (more_parts_shots.gd)

provenance: Authored procedurally in Blender by tools/blender/make_more_creature_parts.py, with helpers from tools/blender/make_creature_parts.py; no external or generated meshes. Textures baked in Blender from procedural shaders.
